name: Stellaria
source:
“My wish is to be able to fly.”
Sorata, who is wandering traveler. He travels around Japan collecting fairy tales and folktales when he stumbles upon an old abandoned lighthouse on the coastal island, rumored to be haunted. According to the local town legend, the old lighthouse is haunted by a girl with long golden hair. She is known as the golden fairy of the island.
translation:
“我的愿望是能够飞翔。”
空太，一位流浪的旅人。他在日本各地旅行，收集童话故事和民间故事，当时他偶然发现沿海岛屿上一座废弃的古老灯塔，据说那里闹鬼。根据当地小镇的传说，古老的灯塔上有一位金色长发的女孩出没。她被称为岛上的黄金仙女。
